forgotPassword.body: Enter your work email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.expBody: Reset links work for 30 minutes and only once. Request a new one below.
forgotPassword.noEmail: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link. It expires in 30 minutes.
forgotPassword.sso: Signing in with Google or SSO? Reset your password with your company's identity provider instead.
forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
inviteAuthenticator.body: AccuKnox asks for a code from your phone each time you sign in, so a stolen password alone can't get in.
inviteAuthenticator.codeErr: That code didn't work. Make sure your phone's time is set automatically, then enter the newest code.
inviteAuthenticator.keyLabel: Can't scan? Use this setup key
inviteAuthenticator.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
inviteAuthenticator.s1: Open an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
inviteAuthenticator.s2: Scan the QR code, or enter the setup key below.
inviteAuthenticator.s3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
inviteAuthenticator.title: Add an authenticator app
invitePassword.body: [Inviter name] invited you to join [Organization] on AccuKnox. Create a password, then add an authenticator to protect your account.
invitePassword.breach: We also check that your password hasn't appeared in a known data breach.
invitePassword.expBody: Invites work for 7 days. Ask [Inviter name] or your admin to send a new one.
invitePassword.title: Set up your account
invitePassword.weakErr: Add at least 1 uppercase letter and 1 special character.
recoveryCodes.body: If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. Store them somewhere safe, like a password manager. You won't see them again.
recoveryCodes.savedErr: Confirm that you've saved your recovery codes to continue.
recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
resetPassword.body: For [name@company.com]. After you save it, sign in with your new password and authenticator.
resetPassword.breach: We also check that your password hasn't appeared in a known data breach.
resetPassword.mismatch: Passwords don't match. Enter the same password in both fields.
resetPassword.successBody: You can now sign in with your new password. For your security, we signed you out on other devices.
resetPassword.title: Set a new password

signIn.openInvite: Open your invite to set up your account
signIn.subtitle: Use your work account to continue.

signIn.wrongBody: Check both and try again. After 5 failed attempts, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes.
signUp.breach: We also check that your password hasn't appeared in a known data breach.
